Watch Chandragupta Maurya Episode - 60 now!
Synopsis :
Chandragupta and his friends learn from Mura about the captivity of Tithiraj. Soon, he makes a plan and informs his friends about it. They fail to find out Tithiraj's whereabouts because of the intervention of Durdhara. Meanwhile, Sthoolbhadra is punished by Daimaa but he succeeds to hide his real intentions. Chanakya introduces Chandragupta and his friends to a unique sap which illuminates in the dark. Dhumketu applies the sap on the sole of the slippers of the servant. Chandragupta follows the illuminated footprints and meets Tithiraj.
